caption:
Meta is making strides in brain-to-text technology with its non-invasive AI, which has demonstrated significant improvements over previous methods. The latest model, Brain2Qwerty v2, shows a word error rate of just 39% compared to 55% in earlier versions. This breakthrough comes from recording extensive brain activity, allowing the AI to decode sentences more accurately than ever.
